versions.changelog:
- Expanded documentation in SKILL.md with new sections: Description, License or terms (MIT), Use case, Risks and mitigations, References, and Ethical considerations.
- Added reference to the CommonMark specification.
- Clarified appropriate and ethical usage guidelines.

- First release of meeting-notes-formatter.
- Converts rough meeting notes into structured Markdown summaries.
- Extracts sections: Summary, Decisions, Action Items (with owners and due dates), and Open Questions.
- Identifies attendees if mentioned; defaults to "Attendees: unknown" otherwise.
- Faithfully reflects provided content without inventing details.
